title: Meet SwiftUI spatial layout
description: Explore new tools for building spatial experiences using SwiftUI. Learn the basics of 3D SwiftUI views on visionOS, customize existing layouts with depth alignments, and use modifiers to rotate and position views in space. Discover how to use spatial containers to align views in the same 3D space, helping you create immersive and engaging apps.
